summary: Signed no-stopping and loading kerb on a UQ campus lane, under dense trees.
reasons: No stopping and loading signs on this kerb

best_section.where: Eastern kerb of Campbell Road below the Social Sciences Building, St Lucia

drivers.seclusion: No homes, but campus buildings 10-24 m away and foot traffic.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs under dense canopy against a building; no wide verge to pull off.
drivers.traffic: Campus service lane with pedestrian crossing at the north end.
drivers.convention: Loading zone and no stopping signs at 1-2 m from the kerb line; paid traffic area.

flags: Signs at the kerb: loading zone, no stopping any time
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the kerb; building shades the east side.
